fields.Name: IT39 - Actions Pipeline
fields.Description: ActionEngine pipeline deterministically: action metadata integrity, param validation on a pure CoreAction, execution log row created+terminal, result-code contract, pinned known-gaps for ValidateInputs/RunSingleFilter stubs per the register, and the structured-failure contract the agent circuit breaker consumes (AP6: failures return Success=false + Message, and input failures never classify as fatal).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: ActionEngine pipeline deterministically: action metadata integrity, param validation on a pure CoreAction, execution log row created+terminal, result-code contract, pinned known-gaps for ValidateInputs/RunSingleFilter stubs per the register.
